info.name: Todo API (C++ / Drogon)
info.description:
End-to-end test suite for the Todo API.

**Setup**
1. Import this collection and `todo-api.local.postman_environment.json`.
2. Select the **Todo API - Local** environment (top-right).
3. Start the API: `docker compose up` (default http://localhost:8080).
4. Open the collection > **Run** and run it top to bottom (folders 00-07 depend on each other).

Every run registers a brand-new user, so it can be repeated. Tokens and ids are stored in the environment automatically.

**Rate limits:** auth endpoints allow 10 requests/minute/IP; one run uses 9. If you re-run within a minute you will get 429s - wait 60 s, or raise `AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN` in docker-compose.yml.

Health endpoints live at `/health` and `/ready`; everything else is under `/api/v1`.

request.description: Liveness probe. Always 200 while the process is up. Note: health routes are NOT under /api/v1.
Readiness probe. 200 only when the database is reachable.
Any unknown route returns the standard JSON error envelope.

item.name: 01 Auth

request.description: Creates a user. A fresh e-mail is generated on every run (user_<timestamp>@example.com) so the collection can be re-run. Password must be at least 10 characters. Saves access_token, refresh_token and user_id to the environment.
Bad e-mail AND a too-short password: both problems are reported in error.details.
Returns a fresh token pair. Saves tokens to the environment.
Requires Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (set automatically from the environment).

item.description: Auth endpoints share a stricter rate limit (10 requests / minute / IP by default). One full run of this collection uses 9 of them.

07 Token lifecycle

request.description: Exchanges the refresh token for a NEW pair. The old refresh token becomes invalid (rotation).

item.name: Replay the OLD refresh token (reuse detection)

request.description: Re-using an already-rotated refresh token is treated as theft: it is rejected AND all of the user's refresh tokens are revoked.

item.name: Newest refresh token is now revoked too

request.description: Revokes the given refresh token. Always 204 (idempotent). The short-lived access token stays valid until it expires - JWTs are stateless.

item.description: Run last: replaying a token revokes every refresh token of the user.
